event.description: Retry the learned rank-7 positional-factorization model with 45000 steps and a 10%-of-base learning-rate floor after its late 96.15% validation trajectory under zero-ending cosine decay.
event.proposal: Family: training control. Retained incumbent is 3430 parameters at 99.660000%, a +0.660000 percentage-point margin over 99%. Same-family history: no accepted training-control candidate; the most recent failed result is attempt-0018, the fixed-basis positional model under a 45000-step learning-rate-floor schedule, an optimization failure that peaked near 10%; 2 prior training-control attempts. The immediately preceding learned rank-7 position attempt-0024 is an optimization failure, not a scored nonqualification: its 3381-parameter model rose steadily to 96.15% validation at step 28000 before the zero-ending cosine left it at 95.95% by step 30000. This is an explicitly changed-condition retry, not a silent retry: the architecture remains rank-7 learned positional factorization, but training changes to 45000 steps with a 10%-of-base learning-rate floor to test whether continued learning clears the checkpoint threshold. It is a training-control intervention, not parameterization-preserving compression. It is more informative than the nearest untested positional rank because it first resolves whether the observed rank-7 trajectory is optimization-limited before making another representational change.
